text.text_excerpt: Wow I really enjoyed coming to Fat Catz! The reason why I'm giving this five stars is because of their awesome cover band! I recently came here on a girls trip and we did some exploring around Bourbon Street and was lured not only by the music but the bouncers as well. We decided to try it. The first night we came the cover band played 70s, 80s, and 90s music. It was awesome, they knew how to get the crowds going! The last two nights had such a large crowded even last night! As far as buying alcohol I did not purchase any but my friends had ordered a Michelada and one of the bartenders did not know what that was. There will be shot girls coming your way for $3 vodka shots, it's not just a...

What a fun lively place to visit on Bourbon! We had such a great time here during our vacation to NOLA and often found ourselves venturing back here each night. They always seemed to have an amazing live band playing, so that's what typically drew us to Fat Catz. They allowed us to bring in our drinks and there was no cover charge! The bartenders were friendly and made great drinks. The various bands that we saw played a wide range of music from everything to jazz to rock. We always end up coming here on our NOLA vacations and I highly recommend if you want to hear some great music on Bourbon!

We love Fat Catz. It is our regular go-to place at night on Bourbon Street. They always have a great band that covers 70s music, with preference it seems to Southern Rock. The musicians are excellent, and are great entertainers. My only reservations about this place are (1) the drinks are overpriced and not as strong as those you get on the street, and (2) they have aides in the restroom who are quite aggressive about helping you (even if you don't want their help) and they do expect a tip whether or not you accept their help. But, all-in-all, Fat Catz is a great bar with great entertainment.
